'''Fenn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the director of [[Troida Corporation]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and speaker for all other corporations during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] occupation of the planet.<ref name="TORBalmorra" />
